_comment: WMS side of the storefront promise (cmd/seed-storefront, WMS step). The CPT (critical pull time) schedule of the fulfilment site in process-path-management (PUT /sites/{siteId}/cpt-schedule). network-fulfillment (SITE_ID site-1) caps every listing's advertised quantity at the process-path capacity before the site's NEXT cutoff of this schedule, and the network declares the same node with the cutoffs and timezone of warehouse-infra scripts/data/retail-network-seed.json (fulfillmentNodes[vendorNodeCode=site-1].profile): the two MUST agree (fixture_test.go and the seeder's CHECK enforce it). CURATED: the cutoff ids, every day of the week, shipMethod ground (the fleet's only method) and the PICK path (the path of customer orders, intake CUSTOMER_ORDER). make warehouse-day never writes this site: it runs on its own site (SIM1) and refuses this siteId (cmd/warehouse-day/site.go) unless -allow-live-site; make provision-storefront restores a schedule that differs.
